title: Derived Weil Representation and Relative Langlands Duality
summary: The Weil representation is a particularly significant linear representation of the metaplectic group, used in the study of theta correspondence. In this paper, I introduce a derived category version of the Weil representation in the local field case. For the dual pair $ (\mathrm{GL}_n,\mathrm{GL}_m) $, I give a coherent description of this category, in the philosophy of relative Langlands duality.
